title: Unbreakable Me - The Gabrielle Daleman Story
original_title: Unbreakable Me - The Gabrielle Daleman Story
overview: This inspiring documentary follows Gabrielle Daleman, two-time Canadian champion and 2018 Olympic gold medalist, as she battles injuries, illness, bullying, and mental health struggles. Beyond the medals and spotlight, she faces adversity with courage and grit, rising again and again to prove that her greatest strength isn't just on the ice - it's in her unbreakable spirit.
